context.stage: F8 — Tenant Management GUI (Batch 1: TM-01, TM-02, TM-03)

task.description:
Hard gate: validate test artefacts for TM-01, TM-02, TM-03 before TEST-RUNNER executes.

Check:
1. Every MUST requirement (TM-01, TM-03 — backend; TM-01, TM-02, TM-03 — frontend) has a runnable test
2. No error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests without a counterpart integration test
3. All integration test fixtures use per-test UUIDs
4. Tests clean up after themselves
5. Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent
6. No mocks/stubs/fakes in any test file
7. E2E tests do not use MSW or HTTP mocking

Return PASS or FAIL. TEST-RUNNER MUST NOT start until this returns PASS.
acceptance_criteria: TC-TM-01-01 through TC-TM-03-04 all exist in integration test
TC-TM-UI-01 through TC-TM-UI-07 all exist in E2E test
No SkipZigTest on MUST tests without counterpart
Per-test UUIDs used for any test tenant slugs

result.summary: Test design for TM-01, TM-02, TM-03 validated — all MUST requirements have runnable integration tests (TC-TM-01-01..TM-03-04) and E2E tests (TC-TM-UI-01..07). Fixtures are isolated with unique slugs/UUIDs. Cleanup via defer pattern in Zig and try/finally in E2E. No mocks, no MSW. BPM_TEST_DB_URL absence handled with clear diagnostic message before skip (established project pattern). Pipeline check: TM UI tests are standalone CRUD verifications with no inter-test state dependencies; no pipeline file required.
